 Cavaliers vs. 76ers picks, odds, prediction, start time: Betting preview for NBA Cup on Friday
 The Cavaliers will host the 76ers in an NBA Cup Group Play game on Friday
 By
 Jason Hall 
 Nov 6, 2026
 at
 6:35 pm ET 
 •
 2 min read
 The NBA Cup will resume with a Group Play matchup between the Philadelphia 76ers (8-1) and the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-4) on Friday at 7:30 p.m. ET. The Sixers have won five consecutive games since their lone loss of the 2026-27 NBA season to the Detroit Pistons on Oct. 25. The Cavaliers are coming off back-to-back losses to the Oklahoma City Thunder on Monday and Wednesday.  76ers vs. Cavaliers betting odds (via FanDuel)
 76ers vs. Cavaliers money line: 76ers -148, Cavaliers +125 
 76ers vs. Cavaliers over/under: 231.5 (Over -110, Under -110) 
 76ers vs. Cavaliers spread:  76ers -2.5 
 76ers vs. Cavaliers betting preview
 The revamped Sixers currently have the best record in the NBA. Veteran guard Tyrese Maxey leads Philadelphia with 28.0 points per game, while newly acquired guard Jaylen Brown is second with 21.8 points per game.
 Donovan Mitchell leads the Cavaliers with 22.5 points per game, which includes 27 points, six assists and three rebounds in Wednesday's loss to the Thunder. Center Evan Mobley is second in scoring with 18.8 points per game and leads Cleveland with 8.3 rebounds per game.  Claim the best Kalshi promo code CBSSPORTS55, trade $25, and receive a $55 bonus here :
 76ers vs. Cavaliers pick, prediction
 PICK: Cavaliers +2.5
 The Sixers defeated the Cavaliers, 114-106, during their previous matchup in Philadelphia on October 22. Mitchell recorded a season-best 32 points and 10 rebounds, while Maxey matched his scoring with 32 points of his own.
 The Cavaliers are 3-1 in four home games, with their first loss taking place on Wednesday. The Sixers have been perfect in their first four road games, which includes a 112-106 win against the Detroit Pistons on Wednesday.
